_about: Small walk-around scenes for places, keyed by place id (data/places.json). Each area is one picture with hotspots. A hotspot's x, y, w, h are fractions of the picture (0 to 1). A hotspot either goes to another area (go), shows a line (look), or does something (do). 'do' actions are built into apps/scene.html: elevator, landlord. Anything that changes your character needs you to be at the place in Explore. Text here sticks to the place's notes and what the art shows.

street.title: Out front
street.text: Five stories of brick, wrapped around a courtyard you can't see from here. Pipes run up the outside where they used to run inside. Most windows are lit. Not all of them are supposed to be.

spots.label: The mural
spots.look: Somebody painted a crowned skull up the side of the building. Somebody else keeps it touched up.

spots.label: The water tower
spots.look: A water tower on the roof, tagged like everything else. The plumbing below it is mostly opinion.

landing.title: The communal landing
landing.text: Two elevators. Neither works often enough for anyone to rely on. Everyone plans on the stairs.

spots.label: The notices
spots.look: A hand-lettered sign: ELEVATOR OUT OF SERVICE (MAIN). SEE STAIRS. The sign looks older than some of the tenants.

spots.label: The crown
spots.look: The same crowned skull as the one out front, smaller, stenciled by the stairs.

fryer.title: The Ground-Floor Fryer
fryer.text: Ma Dresk's fryer, on The Hive's ground floor. She owns the building too, so she always knows who's behind on rent.

spots.label: The fryer
spots.look: Baskets of something golden, hot, and cheap. It smells better than anything else in Low Halo.

spots.label: The sign
spots.look: THE GROUND-FLOOR FRYER. Hand-painted, a basket of fried somethings drawn beside the words.

alley.title: The south service alley
alley.text: The service alley down The Hive's south side. Pipes, dumpsters, wet brick, and more cables than anyone admits to.

spots.label: The mural
spots.look: Spray paint across a roll-up door: COMMUNITY SOLIDARITY. Fresh enough that somebody cares.

spots.label: The crates
spots.look: Red crates stacked against the wall. Whatever was in them is somebody's business.

courtyard.title: The courtyard, from the roof
courtyard.text: From up here you can see the whole U: three wings of windows around a courtyard of planters, tables, and puddles. Thirty-odd units a floor, five floors.

spots.label: The courtyard
spots.look: Tables, planters, string lights. It's the closest thing The Hive has to a living room.

spots.label: The water tower
spots.look: Up close, the tower leans. Nobody's in a hurry to mention it.
